title: 第6章 录名显根
content_zh:
“启禀方执事，弟子李泉，九十三岁。”

    白发老道小心翼翼地说着。

    方执事微微皱眉：“你这个年龄，还想修仙？”

    “还请执事垂怜，弟子此生就这一个执念。”老道小声恳求。

    “也罢，带着我万春谷信物而来，无论能否修成总是要入门的，否则门人带走信物传于后代再无意义。”方执事指向身后石碑，也就是发放“小功”的那一块，“去，将手放在上面，录名显根。”

    “若不得录名，你便不能修仙法，入门终生也只能做仆从。”

    李老道紧张地吞咽一口口水，迈步走到石碑前面，伸手按了上去。

    石碑上缓缓浮现字体：“李泉，九十三岁，杂役弟子，五灵根。”

    李老道有些欣喜，看向方执事：“这算是有灵根了？我不用做仆从？”

    “最差灵根而已。”方执事眼皮都没抬，依旧眯着细眼。

    “下一个。”

    “韩榆，今年十二岁。”

    韩榆对方执事说了之后，见方执事也没理会自己，便走向石碑，将手放上去。

    手心微微一热，随后石碑上显示字体。

    “韩榆，十二岁，杂役弟子，四灵根。”

    方执事有点讶然：“不错，四灵根，你倒是有望入外门。”

    李老道小心翼翼试探着问道：“方执事，我五灵根，也有望入外门吗？”

    方执事嗤笑：“入外门非得修行到练气四层，凭他这四灵根，至少修行十年才有希望。”

    “他能修行十年到练气四层，你这把年龄，灵根又差一筹，还能修行多少年？这辈子能做杂役弟子而不是仆从，就不错了！”

    李老道顿时大为沮丧，嘴巴紧闭。

    方执事又说道：“李泉、韩榆，你们两人去灵田处做杂役弟子，一边修行，一边为宗门种植灵田。”

    “灵田所得收获十成可留两成。”

    “每半年收获灵田，记宗门小功五个。”

    说完之后，手掌在腰间一抹，便有两套灰色杂役弟子衣服，两块淡灰色的玉简，出现在一旁桌子上。

    李老道、韩榆两人上前领了衣服、玉简，方执事又叫来一名穿青衣的外门弟子：“金琦，领他们去分配灵田。”
content_en:
"Deacon Qi reports, disciple Li Quan, ninety-three years old."

The white-haired old man said cautiously.

Deacon Fang frowned slightly: "At your age, you still want to become an immortal?"

"Please have mercy on me, deacon. This is my only obsession in this life." The old Taoist begged in a low voice.

"It doesn't matter, you came here with my Wanchun Valley token. No matter whether you can cultivate it or not, you have to get started. Otherwise, it will be meaningless for the disciples to take away the token and pass it on to future generations." Deacon Fang pointed to the stone tablet behind him, which is the one where the "small merits" are issued. "Go, put your hand on it, record your name and show your roots."

"If you are not registered, you will not be able to practice immortality, and you will only be a servant for the rest of your life."

Li Laodao swallowed nervously, walked up to the stone tablet, and reached out to press it.

The characters slowly appeared on the stone tablet: "Li Quan, ninety-three years old, servant disciple, five spiritual roots."

Li Laodao was a little happy and looked at Deacon Fang: "Does this mean I have spiritual roots? I don't need to be a servant?"

"It's just the worst spiritual root." Deacon Fang didn't even raise his eyelids, still squinting his eyes.

"Next one."

"Han Yu, you are twelve years old this year."

After Han Yu told Deacon Fang, Deacon Fang ignored him, so he walked towards the stone tablet and put his hand on it.

The palm of my hand felt slightly warm, and then the font appeared on the stone tablet.

"Han Yu, twelve years old, servant disciple, four spiritual roots."

Deacon Fang was a little surprised: "Yes, with Four Spiritual Roots, you are expected to enter the outer gate."

Li Laodao asked cautiously and tentatively: "Deacon Fang, with my five spiritual roots, is it possible for me to enter the outer gate?"

Deacon Fang sneered: "To enter the outer sect, you have to practice to the fourth level of Qi training. With his four spiritual roots, he has to practice for at least ten years before he has any hope."

"He has been able to practice for ten years to reach the fourth level of Qi training. At your age and your spiritual abilities are far behind, how many more years can you practice? It would be great to be a handyman disciple instead of a servant in this life!"

Li Laodao was immediately frustrated and closed his mouth tightly.

Deacon Fang added: "Li Quan, Han Yu, you two go to the spiritual field to work as handyman disciples. While practicing, you will plant the spiritual field for the sect."

"Ten percent of the harvest from the spiritual field can be kept 20 percent."

"Every six months, we harvest the spiritual fields and record five small merits of the sect."

After finishing speaking, he touched his waist with his palm, and two sets of gray handyman disciple's clothes and two light gray jade slips appeared on the table beside him.

Li Laodao and Han Yu came forward to receive clothes and jade slips. Deacon Fang called an outer disciple in green clothes: "Jin Qi, take them to allocate the spiritual field."
